evidence_snippets: TensorFlow Enterprise is available to use in the following products: Vertex AI Deep Learning VM Images Deep Learning Containers AI Platform Training One year of support Starting with TensorFlow Enterprise 2.9, each minor release of TensorFlow Enterprise, when used on Google Cloud, is supported with security updates and selected bug fixes for one year.
While it is available in Google Cloud products, patches and bug fixes included in the TensorFlow Enterprise distribution are reflected in the mainline TensorFlow code repository.
Each version of the TensorFlow Enterprise distribution is anchored on a particular version of TensorFlow, and all packages included are available in open source.
